description: This is a unit test class for the LiveCommandAnswerFactory in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.base package. It tests the creation of LiveCommandAnswer instances with various combinations of CommandResponse and Event objects, and verifies their immutability.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing LiveCommandAnswerFactory methods, ensuring correct behavior and immutability in various scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the LiveCommandAnswerFactory class is immutable.

methods.name: getLiveCommandAnswerInstanceWithCommandResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests creation of LiveCommandAnswer with only a CommandResponse.

methods.name: getLiveCommandAnswerInstanceWithNullCommandResponse
methods.description: Tests creation of LiveCommandAnswer with a null CommandResponse.

methods.name: getLiveCommandAnswerInstanceWithEventOnly
methods.description: Tests creation of LiveCommandAnswer with only an Event.

methods.name: getLiveCommandAnswerInstanceWithNullEvent
methods.description: Tests creation of LiveCommandAnswer with a null Event.

methods.name: getLiveCommandAnswerInstanceWithCommandResponseAndEvent
methods.description: Tests creation of LiveCommandAnswer with both CommandResponse and Event.

methods.name: getLiveCommandAnswerInstanceWithNullCommandResponseAndNullEvent
methods.description: Tests creation of LiveCommandAnswer with null CommandResponse and null Event.
